instructions: Verify Save task is disabled while Task name is empty.
Enter Example task in Task name.
Click Save task and hold the saved result for three seconds.
Click More options to reveal Detail note.
Enter Release note in Detail note.
Click Save note and hold the saved result for three seconds.
Enter Review task in Task name.
Confirm in the native dialog and show Dialog confirmed.
Enter Delayed task in Task name.
Observe the pending state, then wait for Delayed save completed.
Enter Cancelled task in Task name.
Click Start delayed save, then Cancel operation before three seconds elapse.
Wait beyond the original deadline; verify Operation cancelled and no saved task.
Enter Relocated task in Task name.
Observe Save task, then click Move Save button.
Reobserve the replaced Save task control in its new position and click it.
